sentences.text:
versus
 The State Nct Of Delhi And Anr .....

Respondent
 Through: Ms. Richa Dhawan, App for State
 with Si Mohit, PS-Bawana.
 Coram:

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VIKAS MAHAJAN  ORDER % 01.12.2025 CRL.M.A. 35545/2025 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

3. The present petition has been filed by petitioners under Section 528 of BNSS seeking quashing of FIR No.421/2024 under Sections 323/341/354/376/34 IPC registered at P.S. Bawana and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom, on the ground that the parties have arrived at a settlement.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that there is no specific allegation of rape.
Ms. Richa Dhawan, learned APP for the State accepts notice.

6. Let status report be filed by the State before the next date of hearing.
7. Re-notify on 17.03.2026.
VIKAS MAHAJAN, J DECEMBER 1, 2025/
